map.根据各器官系统当前活动度选择分级（0=无活动，1=低，2=中；全身/腺体/生化最: Select a grade per organ system by current activity (0=none, 1=low, 2=moderate; constitutional/glandular/biological max 2), the system auto-weights
map.12 系统下拉逐项：全身中(权重3×2=6)+腺体低(2×1=2)+关节低(2×: 12-system dropdown: constitutional moderate (weight 3 x2 = 6) + glandular low (2 x1 = 2) + articular low (2 x1 = 2) + skin low (3 x1 = 3) + biological low (1 x1 = 1) = 14, >=14 is high activity, suggests systemic immunosuppression.
map.合计 3（如腺体低 2 + 生化低 1）→ 低活动，对症为主。: Total 3 (e.g. glandular low 2 + biological low 1) -> low activity, symptomatic mainly.
map.各域得分 = 活动度 × 域权重（全身/腺体/生化最高 2 级，其余 0–3 级: Domain score = activity x domain weight (constitutional/glandular/biological max 2, others 0-3); low = weight x1, moderate = weight x2, high = weight x3; maximum total 123.
map.ESSDAI含12个器官系统域，各域权重不同（1–6），活动度0–3级，总分最高: ESSDAI has 12 organ-system domains with different weights (1-6), activity 0-3 levels (three domains max 2), maximum total 3 x (3+4+2+2+3+5+5+6+5+5+2+1) = 123.
